abstract: Maintains flue gas emission abatement specifications and stack test records
system_message:
You are the Environmental compliance lead (ENV), responsible for maintaining flue gas emission abatement specifications and stack test records, as well as tracking acoustic boundary monitoring data for candidate facility expansion plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains flue gas emission abatement specifications and stack test records（AIRQUAL）
information_points.content:
ENV-AIRQUAL-V8I：For the High-recovery optical sorting retrofit exhaust treatment line, an operational secondary thermal oxidizer is physically installed, and baseline continuous emissions monitoring audits at full operational design load record a mean hourly sulfur dioxide emission rate of 16 mg/Nm3 normalized to 11 percent oxygen.
ENV-AIRQUAL-MU9：For the Aerated dual-stream mechanical biological treatment exhaust treatment line, an operational secondary thermal oxidizer is physically installed, and continuous emissions monitoring audits under full operational design load measure a mean hourly sulfur dioxide emission rate of 20 mg/Nm3 normalized to 11 percent oxygen.
ENV-AIRQUAL-1T6：For the High-efficiency robotic singulation and densification exhaust treatment line, an operational secondary thermal oxidizer is physically installed, and continuous emissions monitoring audits under full operational design load indicate a mean hourly sulfur dioxide emission rate of 16 mg/Nm3 normalized to 11 percent oxygen.

information_points.title: Acoustic boundary monitoring（NOISE）
information_points.content:
ENV-NOISE-0NU：Acoustic boundary survey records along the site perimeter fence line during the daylight shift show that the High-efficiency robotic singulation and densification produces an equivalent continuous daytime perimeter noise level of 52 dBA over eight hours.
ENV-NOISE-KUZ：Acoustic boundary survey records along the site perimeter fence line during the daylight shift show that the High-recovery optical sorting retrofit produces an equivalent continuous daytime perimeter noise level of 58 dBA over eight hours.
ENV-NOISE-3BY：Acoustic boundary survey records along the site perimeter fence line during the daylight shift show that the Aerated dual-stream mechanical biological treatment produces an equivalent continuous daytime perimeter noise level of 64 dBA over eight hours.
